scope: Read-only inspection of all seven 430x932@3x master/build pairs plus all seven build states in each of four combinations:430x932 scale1.0,375x667 scale1.0,375x667 scale1.3,430x932 scale1.3.28 build images reviewed. No app change, test driver, threshold or waiver.

verdict.explanation: All locked components, sample content and represented states are present. Native font raster/metrics, shared surfaces and small resulting geometry differences remain visible; numerical conformity and readable layout are not called pixel MATCH. No missing component, unintended overlap, ellipsis or non-scroll clipping was identified in the reviewed images. This is a visual review, not Founder/designer acceptance.
verdict.four_combo_explanation: All28 images reviewed. No new material issue, unintended word splitting, ellipsis, overlap or non-scroll cutoff was observed in the two added combinations. Partial neighboring chips and partial rows at scroll-viewport edges are expected horizontally/vertically scrollable content, not whole-label truncation.

shared_native_baseline.preserved: Reader cards use existing ZyraFloatingSurface, ZyraColors.cardSurface and ZyraColors.surfaceBorder; typography uses existing ZyraText. Those shared files and preexisting Help/Privacy presentation have no line149 diff.
shared_native_baseline.accepted_line145_context: Root identifies the full-opacity/shared shadow treatment as accepted line145 behavior required to preserve; visual review does not propose reverting it to prototype shadows.
visible_common_differences: Native body and section-heading glyphs look heavier/darker than prototype raster.
Native cards have more pronounced lower shadows and a more defined edge than prototype cards.
Reader card inset is22pt in code, while prototype cards appear approximately20pt; this is a small visible width difference, recorded without claiming exact pixel parity.
Native text metrics and fixed header/chip heights move subsequent content slightly upward; content order and numeric type sizes are retained.
